R0213.title: Edge Computing Node Attack
R0213.definition: Attackers compromise IoT edge computing nodes to steal locally processed sensitive data or tamper with AI inference results.

references.title: AIoT security: edge computing node security

R0213.description:
Edge computing node attacks target local compute resources deployed in stores, factories, base stations, vehicles, or campuses. Attackers can use physical access, weak operations accounts, container flaws, or exposed services to steal data or alter inference results.

Edge nodes are distributed and often lack data center-grade controls. Design needs trusted boot, remote attestation, least privilege, and auditable behavior during disconnected operation.
R0213.influence: Compromised edge nodes can leak local sensitive data, alter AI inference, and become distributed footholds outside central data centers.

observables: Edge nodes show signs of weak ops accounts or exploited container vulnerabilities
Edge AI inference results show systematic tampering under specific inputs
Edge node local data is abnormally exported or exfiltrated
Node trusted-boot or remote-attestation checks fail but are not blocked
Edge nodes show unaudited anomalous operations during network-disconnected scenarios
